intro: Fraise chair turns dining into comfort you look forward to. Its plush seat and warm hue invite you to relax, while the sturdy base with optional swivel gives you dining your way every day.

features.title: Cushioned comfort that feels personal
features.text: Sink into the padded seat and back that ease pressure points, making even long dinners or late-night chats feel natural and relaxed.

features.title: Supportive curved backrest design
features.text: The contoured shape follows your spine to keep you upright yet comfortable, so posture feels natural while you enjoy your meal.

features.title: Diverse leg base options to suit your needs
features.text: Built for dynamic living, the 5-prong base ensures smooth rolling, full swivel, and tilt that adjusts to you—making every sit flexible yet stable.

features.title: Toffee finish that blends with ease
features.text: The rich tone adds a cozy yet modern charm, complementing both casual dining spaces and formal settings effortlessly.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading
